name: twentyfour26
long_description:
At twentyfour26, we are developing standardized manufacturing cells that bring machines, tooling, workholding, and inspection under a single system. Our models are being developed to interpret CAD designs, plan machining strategies, select tooling and setups, and operate the machines.

We're already manufacturing components for hardware companies in and around the Bay Area, with turnaround times as fast as ~48 hours. Operating our own machines allows us to develop and deploy automation against real production workloads.

Our goal is to make manufacturing 100 different designs as easy as manufacturing 100 units of the same design.

From individual components to complete assemblies, we want to abstract the entire manufacturing infrastructure into an API.
one_liner: Building Autonomous Factories in America, Starting with On-Demand CNC…
